levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Most categories left blank with no engagement, not even an honest 'no one yet.'

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All five categories have either a role label or an honest recorded gap.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Gaps are named specifically enough to act on (e.g., 'no one for health questions yet') rather than a blanket 'not sure.'

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: A full name, address, phone number, or other identifying detail appears anywhere in the response.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Only role/relationship labels are used throughout, with no identifying details.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Role labels are specific enough to be useful to the learner (e.g., 'my aunt' vs. just 'family') while still non-identifying to an outside reader.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Next step is vague ('try to find someone') with no concrete action.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Next step is a concrete, realistic action tied to the named gap.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Next step includes a rough timeframe or trigger for when the learner will actually take it.

lookFors: No full name, address, or contact detail appears anywhere in the response; only role/relationship labels.
Every one of the five categories has either a role label or an honestly recorded gap, not a blank.
The named next step is specific enough that a guardian reading it could recognize whether it happened.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
